newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BECKENBAUER ATTACKS ENGLISH WORLD CUP BID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BECKENBAUER ATTACKS ENGLISH WORLD CUP BID.

text.p: Franz Beckenbauer launched a fierce attack on English soccer officials on Tuesday for running a rival bid against Germany to host the 2006 World Cup finals.
"The English have left us in the lurch. We expected the English to support us. This has got nothing to do with English fair play," Beckenbauer said to applause at a gala to back Germany's bid.
The Germans launched their cup campaign in 1993 under the impression that the English F.A. would support them as Europe's leading candidate.
But the English body decided to run a rival bid after last year's succesful staging of the European championship finals.
Speaking in front of UEFA officials and leading German players, Beckenbauer said that the Germans thought the English had agreed to support them.
"The English have been a very important motor in the develepment of world football and I have good relations with the English. That was why I was very disappointed.
"The English themselves are okay, but the Football Association has to look at whether it is in order."
FIFA does not decide until the year 2000 which country will host the finals. Rival bids are also expected from South America and Africa.
But the Germans believe that only one bid should only come from Europe otherwise the continent will find it difficult to stage the finals.
